title: CLARE-RINEYA-001 artifact schemas
description: Every number carries one of three labels. MEASURED: read directly from a scored row, a delta or a mask. DERIVED: computed by clare.metrics / clare.geometry / clare.functional from MEASURED values. HYPOTHESIZED: an interpretation; allowed only in RESULTS.md prose and marked there, never in these files.

scored_row.description: MEASURED. One line of runs/<run>/scores.jsonl, appended and fsync'd as it is produced (evaluator.score_generation).

correct.description: MAXRL-COMP-002 verifier.score on the decoded response (strict JSON, any valid certificate)

terminated.description: generation stopped at an EOS id (151645 or 151643) within max_new_tokens

response.description: decoded generation WITHOUT the EOS token

skill_manifest.description: MEASURED provenance of one trained skill delta (runs/<run>/manifests/NN_<skill>.json; clare.manifests.skill_manifest).

selected_coordinates.description: ALLOCATED capacity (mask size); null for dense arms

active_nonzero_coordinates.description: non-zero values of the trained delta; <= selected_coordinates for masked arms

delta_checksum.description: representation-independent: sha256 over the dense-equivalent float32 bytes in footprint order

retention_matrix.description: DERIVED from prefix:k scored rows on atomic signatures (clare.metrics.retention_matrix). Same rows at every stage, or it refuses.

composition_matrix.description: DERIVED accuracy on combination signatures at every prefix stage that covers them and at the final stage (clare.metrics.composition_matrix).

paired_contrast.description: DERIVED paired comparison of two configurations on IDENTICAL rows (clare.metrics.paired): gains, losses, net, exact McNemar p, parent-cluster bootstrap 95% interval.

pair_interaction.description: MEASURED teacher-forced log-probabilities and DERIVED interaction for one skill pair (evaluator.pair_interaction). Measures the second difference of the reference answer's log-probability and of the log-softmax vectors; it is NOT composition accuracy.

delta_geometry_row.description: DERIVED geometry for one pair of skill deltas (clare.geometry.pair_geometry). For strict disjoint arms support_intersection = 0 and dot = 0.0 BY CONSTRUCTION (a mechanical check, not a finding).

companion_files.allocation_by_layer__<arm>__s<seed>__<or: MEASURED; clare.masks.layer_table (available before, selected, fractions per slot and skill)
companion_files.delta_geometry.csv: DERIVED; one delta_geometry_row per skill pair per run
companion_files.scored_rows.csv: MEASURED; scored_row without the response text (responses stay in scores.jsonl)
